edges.description: Active-site variants are expected to reduce charging of tRNA(Asp) with aspartate. This has been measured only for selected alleles in an overexpression assay, and one disease allele (D367Y) did not reduce activity there, so the edge is an allele-dependent expectation.

Charged tRNA(Asp) is a prerequisite for translation, so reduced charging is expected to impair protein synthesis. Reduced translation has not been measured directly in HBSL patient cells or in the hypomorphic mice.

nodes.description: Biallelic germline DARS1 variants, mostly missense, alter highly conserved residues in or next to the active-site pocket of the C-terminal catalytic lobe of cytoplasmic aspartyl-tRNA synthetase (AspRS). Because complete loss of Dars1 is embryonic lethal in mice, disease alleles are inferred to retain residual function. Allele effects are not uniform: in an overexpression assay in HEK293 lysates A274V abolished aminoacylation while D367Y slightly increased it, so a simple loss of catalytic activity is not demonstrated for every allele.

nodes.description: Homozygous D367Y knock-in mice were phenotypically normal, so the allele was placed in trans to a null allele. D367Y/- mice show embryonic developmental delay, reduced birth rate, early hydrocephalus and microphthalmia, then late-onset motor deficits with spinal cord white matter vacuolization and demyelination and reduced myelin protein expression.

Homozygous M256L mice were only mildly affected despite severe human disease. M256L/- mice show embryonic lethality, developmental delay, small size, hydrocephalus, anophthalmia and white matter vacuolization, with metabolic and peripheral-organ changes more prominent than the neurological ones.

Dars1-null embryos die before embryonic day 11. Heterozygotes have substantially reduced brain DARS1 levels but no gross abnormality and normal motor performance, with reduced pre-pulse inhibition of the acoustic startle response.

The tissue-level lesion that names the disease: hypomyelination in a tract-selective pattern involving the supratentorial white matter, the anterior brainstem and cerebellar peduncles, and the dorsal columns and lateral corticospinal tracts of the spinal cord. Adolescent-onset cases can have only minor focal cerebral lesions with the full spinal pattern, and some children have normal spinal MRI. Conformance to the CNS myelin failure module is claimed at the myelin-sheath node only: DARS1 is not an oligodendrocyte-specific gene, so the module's oligodendrocyte-lineage trigger node is not claimed.

nodes.description: The proposed cellular consequence. DARS1 is expressed in all cells but is enriched in neurons, where it is found in the soma with the translation machinery and also along neurites and at synapses, and it is low in oligodendrocytes, astrocytes and microglia. Which cell type is primarily injured, and whether local translation in axons or synapses is involved, is not established. The node is a hypothesis carried by the expression data and the enzyme's function, not a measured translation defect.
